items.q: from RCA Victor, from Leonard Joy who was a big man there, saying to come back.

ctx.x: so he hired a new singer called Helen Forrest. And we went to St. Louis, and in the middle of the engagement, after a week or two in St. Louis, he got a call one day from RCA Victor -- this is only two months later -- from RCA Victor, from Leonard Joy who was a big man there, saying to come back. He was already gonna dissolve the band, now. But Begin the Beguine and the record date is a sensation, it is sweeping the nation.
Well, as a bunch of kids, you don't know how thrilled we were. So we booked one date, we had a battle of music with some band, the house band, at the Savoy in Chicago.
